description: Classification-aware UNION across insider transactions (latest post_transaction_shares per insider), 13F institutional holdings, and SC 13D / 13G blockholder filings for one issuer.  Each row carries holder_class ∈ {insider, institutional, blockholder_13D, blockholder_13G}.  Dedupes overlapping filers by precedence (13D > 13G > institutional > insider).  One call, classified cap table — Bloomberg charges separately for INSIDER<GO>, OWNER<GO>, and HDS<GO>; this consolidates them.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD): only filings ACCEPTED by SEC on or before this date are considered across all three sources (institutional via accepted_at, insider via accepted_at, blockholders via accepted_at). Excludes amendments/late filings accepted after this date (zero look-ahead). Omit for the latest knowable cap table.

include_superseded.description: Default false: 13F-HR rows replaced by a later 13F-HR/A are hidden once the amendment is knowable (as of as_of_date when given), so an original and its amendment are never both counted. Set true to include the superseded originals.

period_end.description: 13F REPORTING period_end. Omit for latest. NOT a point-in-time cutoff — use as_of_date.

ticker.description: Issuer ticker symbol — or a CIK (SEC identifier).

top_n.description: Maximum holders to return, ranked by shares. Default 25.

name: get_top_holders

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

as_of_date.description: The point-in-time cutoff actually applied (echo of the as_of_date input). Null when no PIT cut was requested. NEVER equal to period_end unless explicitly supplied — a reporting period is not a knowable-as-of date.

period_end.description: The institutional 13F REPORTING period — NOT a point-in-time cutoff.

co_filers.description: Other members of the same group filing collapsed into this row (13D/G co-filers).

metrics_display.description: This holder's shares, market value and percent_owned rendered for prose ('1.28B shares', '$347.72B', '8.45%'). QUOTE THESE VERBATIM.

observation_date.description: Date the holding was observed (13F period_end, 13D/G as-of/filing date, or insider transaction_date). NOT a point-in-time cutoff — see the top-level as_of_date.

percent_basis.description: Denominator for percent_owned. 13F = share of covered 13F float; 13D/G = percent of shares outstanding. Not comparable across bases.

shares.description: Null when the source filing did not report a share count — MISSING, not a real 0 (never emit 0 for an absent holding).

staleness.description: Each source has its own as-of date and lag (13F ~45-day lag; 13D/G snapshots can be years old). Percentages from different-dated denominators are NOT directly comparable.

title: Top Holders (composite, classified)
